{{Quote|Ladies, gentlemen, womp rats, bounty hunters, tyrants, kings and ''worse''! The ''Clawfish Roaming Auction of Illicit and Illegal Weaponry'' is ''proud'' to present&hellip; the ''Venomator''!|[[Clawfish]]|<ref name="Under the Hammer" />}}
The '''Clawfish Roaming Auction of Illicit and Illegal Weaponry''' was a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] operation run by [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] [[Clawfish]]. In around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the organization tried to sell the ''[[Venomator]]'' to the highest bidder on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Callos]].
